Bheka ikhi ephezulu kwegridi. Umbala ngamunye unenombolo negama, njengo-1 Phuzi.
Thinta umbala ekhi, bese uthinta izikwele ofuna ukuzigcwalisa ngawo.
Sebenzisa umbala ofana nenombolo, noma noma yimuphi umbala othanda wona. Zombili ziyamukeleka.
Thinta “Gcwalisa ngamanani” ngezikwele ezingenalutho, “Sula” ukuqala igridi kabusha, noma “Esinye isithombe” ngesinye.
tips: Hlalani eceleni nilandelane: omunye akhethe umbala, omunye athinte isikwele.
Khulumani ngemibala: “Ngithanda oluhlaza.” Akudingeki nichaze ukuthi isithombe sizoba yini.
Esikrinini esincane igridi ye-8 ngo-8 ihamba ngokuya ngasohlangothini ngaphakathi kwebhokisi yayo. Izikwele zihlala ngosayizi ofanele.
Inguqulo yephepha nayo isebenza kahle ngopensile etafuleni elisecaleni kombhede.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho iwashi, amaphuzu, ukubala kokunyakaza noma ukulahlekelwa. Ungayeka noma nini, futhi ukuyeka uphakathi nendawo kuyindlela efanelekile yokuqeda.

faq.q: Kuthiwani uma ngisebenzisa umbala ohlukile kunenombolo?
faq.a: Akukho lutho olwenzekayo, futhi yiloko okubalulekile. Noma yimuphi umbala ungafakwa kunoma yisiphi isikwele, futhi umdlalo awusho lutho ngakho. Lapho sonke isikwele sinombala wenombolo yaso, umdlalo uyakutshela ngobumnene, kanti isithombe ngemibala yakho siba lihle ngokufanayo.

faq.q: Ingabe abantu abanesiphofu semibala bayakwazi ukwehlukanisa imibala emine?
faq.a: Ikhethelwe lokho. Umbala ngamunye unenombolo, negama elibhaliwe, nesimo sawo esincane, ngakho umbala awusoze ube yindlela yodwa yokuwehlukanisa. Imibala emine ihlolwe ngokulingisa isiphofu semibala obomvu-oluhlaza nesiphuzi-oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, futhi ihlukile nangokukhanya. Umuntu onesiphofu semibala akakayilingi, ngakho sicela usitshele uma imibala emibili ibukeka ifana.

faq.q: Ingabe izikwele zikhulu ngokwanele ngenxa yokunyakaza kwesandla noma isikrini esincane?
faq.a: Isikwele ngasinye sinobubanzi obungenani lama-48 wamapikseli, kanti ku-56 egridini ye-4 ngo-4. Uma igridi imekude kakhulu nesikrini, ihamba ngokuya ngasohlangothini ngaphakathi kwebhokisi yayo kunokuba izikwele zincipha.
Yebo. Ishidi elilodwa linegridi enezinombolo nekhi yemibala emine enamagama ayo. Dweba isikwele ngasinye ngopensile wombala ofana nenombolo yaso, noma noma yimuphi umbala othanda wona.

faq.q: Kuyamahala yini, futhi kudingeka ukuzibhalisa na?
faq.a: Yebo, mahala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukudawuniloda. Isebenza kwisiphequluli sewebhu esiselufonini, kwithebulethi noma kukhompyutha.

pattern-maker.name: Umenzi wephethini
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Umenzi Wephethini: Yakha Ithayela Bese Uprinta Iphethini
pattern-maker.h1: Umenzi Wephethini: Yakha ithayela, ubone libuyela liphindaphinde
pattern-maker.description: Shintsha izikwele zethayela elincane bese ubona libuyela liphindaphinde libe yiphethini ngasecaleni, ngemibala emine enegama nesimo sayo. Akukho sikhathi noma amaphuzu. Umdlalo mahala ukuwudlala nokuwuprinta.
pattern-maker.short: Shintsha izikwele zethayela elincane bese ubona libuyela liphindaphinde libe yiphethini.
pattern-maker.intro: Ithayela elincane lezikwele ezi-3 ngo-3, noma ezi-4 ngo-4 uma ufuna, kanti ecaleni kwalo kukhona “iphethini yakho”: ithayela elifanayo elibuyela liphindaphinde libe yibhlokhi. Thinta isikwele silanduke sibe ngombala olandelayo kwemibala emine, ngayinye inegama layo elibhaliwe nesimo sayo. Iphethini ecaleni kwalo ishintsha ngokushesha. Akukho phethini efanele, futhi akukho okugcinwayo noma okuthunyelwayo. “Printa iphethini yami” ibeka iphethini ephindaphindiwe ekhasini elilodwa ukuze uyigcine, uyigcwalise ngemibala noma uyinikeze omunye.
howTo: Bheka ithayela nephethini yakho ecaleni kwalo. Yithayela elifanayo, elibuyela liphindaphinde.
Thinta isikwele. Silanduka sibe ngombala olandelayo kumugqa wemibala emine ongaphezulu.
Qhubeka uthinta izikwele kuze iphethini ibukeke njengoba ufuna. Noma iyiphi iphethini ingeyamuhle.
Thinta “Mangaza mina” ngethayela elisha, noma “Qala kabusha” ngelingenalutho. “Buyisela” ibuyisela ithayela obenalo.
Thinta “Printa iphethini yami” uma ufuna ukuyibona ephepheni, noma uthinte “Phumula” ukuze umise.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Talk about what you see: "That looks like a flower." There is no need to name anything.
Try the same tile in just two colors, then again in all four.
On paper, the pattern can be colored in with pencils, cut into strips for a card, or used to wrap a small gift.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything I make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. Your tile stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page. If you would like to keep a pattern, print it.

faq.q: What if I tap the wrong square or clear the tile by accident?
faq.a: There is no wrong square: tap it again to move on to the next color. After "Start again" or "Surprise me", "Put it back" brings back the tile you had.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each square, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the squares big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every square is at least 56 pixels across. If the tile is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.
Yes. "Print my pattern" prints the pattern you made on one page, with the four colors and their names, fine in black and white because every color has its own shape.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

drawing-duet.name: Drawing duet
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Picture
drawing-duet.h1: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Sheet
drawing-duet.description: Two people take turns drawing lines on one shared canvas, each in a color of their own. Nobody scores or wins, and the picture can be saved or printed. Free to play, with no account.
drawing-duet.short: Take turns drawing one shared picture with someone beside you.
drawing-duet.intro: One canvas, two people. Each of you picks a color, and each color has its own written name. You take turns: draw one line or shape, then pass the pen. Either of you may pass at any time. There is no right picture and no score. Save the picture to your device if you like it, or print the paper version: one sheet, two pens.
howTo: Each of you picks a color. The banner says whose turn it is, with that person's color by name.
Draw one line or shape with a finger, a mouse or a pen. Or use the arrow keys and Space to draw without a pointer.
When you are ready, tap "Pass the pen". Either of you may pass at any time.
Tap "Take back my last line" to remove the newest line of the person whose turn it is.
Tap "Save picture" to make a picture file on this device, or "Print the paper version" for one sheet and two pens.
tips: Sit side by side and talk as you draw: "I will add a sun in the corner."
Start with a dot, a line or a simple shape, and let the other person answer it.
Nobody has to draw a picture of anything. A pattern of lines is just as good as a scene.
If you want to stop, tap "Done for now". Your picture is not kept after you leave the page unless you save it.

faq.q: Is there a winner or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no winner, no score, no timer and no count of turns. There is no right picture, and nothing is ranked or compared.

faq.q: Is the picture saved or sent?
faq.a: No, nothing is sent anywhere. The picture stays on this page until you close it. If you tap Save picture, a file is made on your device for you to download. Nothing is uploaded.

faq.q: Can I take back a line?
faq.a: Yes. "Take back my last line" removes the newest line of the person whose turn it is. "Start again" clears the sheet, and "Put it back" brings the lines back, one step only.

faq.q: Can I use this without a mouse or touch screen?
faq.a: Yes. When the drawing has focus, the arrow keys move a pen dot, and the Space key puts the pen down or up. The screen says "Pen down" or "Pen up" each time.

faq.q: What colors are they, and can people with color-blindness tell them apart?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green and purple, the same four colors used in our other picture games. Each has a written name, and the names show beside the turn. The colors were checked with simulations of common color-vision differences, but a person with color-vision differences has not yet tried them.
Yes. "Print the paper version" prints one sheet with the rules on it and a large blank frame to draw in, for two people with two pens. It works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Ee, kwa mahhala, kwaye akudingeki ube nakhawunti, ubhalise noma ulande lutho. Lisebenza ku-browser yewebhu efoni, ithebhulethi noma ikhompyutha.

build-together.name: Akha ndawonye
build-together.seoTitle: Akha Ndawonye: Abantu Ababili Bakha Iphethini Eyodwa
build-together.h1: Akha Ndawonye: Abantu Ababili, Igridi Eyodwa
build-together.description: Abantu ababili bayathatha amathuba okubeka isiqephu esigcwaleni esabelwanwa, kuze kugcwale, ngamunye enombala wakhe onegama nesimo sawo. Akekho owina, kwaye akukho sikhathi noma amaphuzu. Mahhala ukudlala nokuprinta.
build-together.short: Thathani amathuba nomuntu eduze nawe ukugcwalisa igridi eyodwa eyabelwanwayo.
build-together.intro: Igridi eyabelwanwayo enezikhala ezi-4 ngezi-4, noma ezi-3 ngezi-3 uma uthanda. Ngamunye wenu ukhetha umbala, kwaye umbala ngamunye unegama lawo elibhaliwe nesimo sawo. Nithatha amathuba: ngethuba lakho, thepha isikhala esingenalutho ukuze ubeke isiqephu sakho khona. Lapho zonke izikhala sezinesiqephu, isithombe sesakhiwe ndawonye. Akekho owina, ngoba nakha njengabantu ababili, futhi akukho okugcinwa noma okuthunyelwayo. "Printa igridi" ibeka igridi engenalutho ekhasini elilodwa ukuze nakhe ngamapensela amabili.
howTo: Ngamunye wenu ukhetha umbala. Umbala umuntu omunye ayisebenzisayo umakwa ngokuthi "Isasetshenziswa".
Umuntu wokuqala uqala. Isikrini sitshela ukuthi yiyiphi ithuba nokuthi yimuphi umbala walowo.
Thepha isikhala esingenalutho ukuze ubeke isiqephu sakho khona. Ithuba lidlulela komunye umuntu.
Uma ungathanda ukungabeka isiqephu, thepha "Dlula". Noma ngubani wenu angadlula noma nini.
Lapho zonke izikhala sezinesiqephu, sewakhe isithombe ndawonye. Thepha "Qala futhi" ukuze wakhe esinye, noma thepha Phumula ukuze umise.
tips: Hlalani eduze komunye nomunye ukuze nobabili nibone futhi nifinyelele isikrini. Khulumani njengoba nisenza: "Mina ngizobeka eyami eduze kwakho."
Zamani ukwakha iphethini, imigqa, ibhodi lamasikwele noma umphetho, noma nje beka iziqephu noma yiphi indawo oyithandayo. Kokubili kulungile.
Ingane noma umuntu odinwa kalula angadlula kangangoba efisa. Isithombe sisakhiwa ndawonye.
Ephepheni, ngamunye usebenzisa ipensela elilodwa adwebe isimo sakhe ezikwele ezingenalutho.

faq.q: Kukhona umuntu owinayo, isikhathi noma amaphuzu?
faq.a: Cha. Akekho owina, ngoba nakha isithombe esisodwa ndawonye. Akukho iwashi, amaphuzu, ukubalwa kweziqephu noma ukulahleka. Ungayeka noma nini, futhi ukuyeka uphakathi kuyindlela elungile yokuqeda.
Cha. Igridi ihlala kulolu khasi kuphela. Ayigcinwa, ayilayishwa noma ayibalwa, futhi inyamalala uma uvala ikhasi. Uma ufuna ukuyigcina, printa igridi wakhe ephepheni.

faq.q: Yini uma ngibeka isiqephu endaweni engalungile?
faq.a: Akukho ndawo engalungile. Thepha "Thatha isiqephu sokugcina emuva" ithuba libuyele kuwe. Ungathatha isinyathelo esisodwa ngesikhathi, futhi nokudlula kungathathwa emuva.

faq.q: Ingabe abantu abanobuthuthwane bemibala bayakwazi ukuhlukanisa imibala emine?
faq.a: Yakhethwa ukuze yenze lokho. Umbala ngamunye unegama lawo elibhaliwe nesimo sawo esincane kusiqephu ngasinye, ngakho umbala awusoze ube yindlela eyodwa yokuwahlukanisa. Imibala emine ihlolwe ngokulingisa ubuthuthwane bemibala obubomvu-oluhlaza nobuluhlaza-obuphuzi. Umuntu onobuthuthwane bemibala akakayizami, ngakho sicela usitshele uma imibala emibili ifana.

faq.q: Ingabe izikhala zikhulu ngokwanele ngenxa yokuthuthumela noma isikrini esincane?
faq.a: Ikhala ngalinye linobubanzi obungenani lama-56 amaphikseli. Uma igridi inkulu kakhulu esikrinini, iyashuka ngokuphuma ngapha nangapha ngaphakathi kwebhokisi layo kunokuncipha kwezikhala.
Yebo. "Printa igridi" iprinta igridi engenalutho ekhasini elilodwa nemibala emibili namagama alo, ukuze wakhe ngamapensela amabili. Isebenza ngomnyama nomhlophe ngoba umbala ngamunye unesimo sawo.
Yebo, kwahhala, kwaye akudingeki inakhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda lutho. Lisebenza ku-browser yewebhu efoni, ithebhulethi noma ikhompyutha.

seated-toss.name: Ukubala kokuphosa kwasesihlalweni
seated-toss.seoTitle: Ukubala Kokuphosa Kwasesihlalweni: Umdlalo Wesikhwama Sembewu Kubantu Ababili
seated-toss.h1: Ukubala Kokuphosa Kwasesihlalweni: Phosani Ndawonye Etafuleni
seated-toss.description: Abantu ababili etafuleni bayathatha amathuba okuphonsa isikhwama esithambile sembewu esibhekeni esikhulu, bagcine ukubala ephepheni. Akukho sikhathi noma amaphuzu. Mahhala ukuprinta.
seated-toss.short: Thathani amathuba okuphonsa isikhwama sembewu esibhekeni esikhulu, nokubala kube ephepheni.
seated-toss.intro: Umdlalo wokuphosa ophakathi nendawo kubantu ababili abahlezi etafuleni. Libeka isibhekela esiprintiwe etafuleni bese nithatha amathuba okuphonsa isikhwama esithambile sembewu, noma isokisi eligoqiwe, ukuze siwele emphongolweni. Ngamunye wenu ugcina ukubala ngokumaka amabhokisi ephepheni, nibheke okumakiwe ndawonye nilapho nimisa. Akukho sikhathi esibalwayo, akukho okungezwa esikrinini, futhi akukho okugcinwa noma okuthunyelwayo. Sicela ufunde izaziso zokuphepha kuqala: izinto ezincane ezigcwele ngaphakathi zingaba yingozi yokuqunjelwa.
howTo: Funda izaziso zokuphepha. Khetha isikhwama esinesivalo esifakwe ngomthungo, noma goqa isokisi elihlanzekile.
Thepha "Printa isibhekela nephepha lokubala" ubeke ishidi lisicaphele etafuleni phakathi kwenu.
Hlalani ngokuthula, omunye ohlangothini ngalunye, nithathe amathuba ngokuphosa kancane kancane kanye ngamunye. Noma ubani angadlula.
Uma iphosa lifika emphongolweni, makha ibhokisi esikholomini sakho, emugqeni walowo mphongolo.
Bhekani okumakiwe ndawonye lapho nimisa, noma thepha Phumula ukuze nimise isikhashana.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "That was a soft one." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is it safe to toss a bean bag?
faq.a: It can be, with care. Use a bag with a sewn-shut cover or a rolled-up sock, never loose beans, rice or small fillings, which are a choking hazard for young children and for anyone who puts things in their mouth. Stay seated, toss gently toward the table and never toward a face, and keep an adult close by.

faq.q: Is anything counted or saved on the screen?
faq.a: No. The tally is only on paper, in boxes you tick yourselves. The page keeps no count and no timer, and nothing is saved or sent.

faq.q: What if someone cannot toss, or the bag lands off the sheet?
faq.a: Anyone may pass, and a bag that lands off the sheet is simply picked up for the next turn. Nothing is counted for it.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page: a large target with its three rings named Near, Middle and Far, a table with a column for each person and a row of small boxes to tick for each ring, and a line of safety advice. The names are written on the rings, so it works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

seasonal-pack.name: Seasonal puzzle pack
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Printable Paper Puzzles
seasonal-pack.h1: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Three Paper Puzzles for Each Season
seasonal-pack.description: Three small printable puzzles for spring, summer, autumn or winter: match the pairs, circle the one that is different, and color a picture in. Choose a season, or take a rest day. Free to print.
seasonal-pack.short: Three printable puzzles for the season you choose, or a rest day.
seasonal-pack.players: All ages, solo or side by side
seasonal-pack.intro: Choose a season, and the page shows three small paper puzzles drawn from that season's pictures: two rows to join with lines, a row of four to circle the one that is different, and a picture to color in. You print one page, then do one, two or all three, at your own pace. Choose "Today is a rest day" instead and there is nothing to do.
howTo: Choose a season, or choose "Today is a rest day".
Look at the three puzzles, then tap "Print this season's pack".
Do one, two or all three, at your own pace.
Join the matching pictures with a line, circle the one that is different, and color the large picture in.
Stop whenever you like. A rest day is a good day too.
tips: Start with the puzzle that feels easiest today. One is enough.
Say the name of each picture aloud, if that helps.
Use crayons or pencils. Any colors are fine.
Keep the page for next time, or let it go.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Does the page know which season it is?
faq.a: No. You choose the season. The page does not look at the date or your location.

faq.q: Is there a score or a right answer?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or checked on the screen, and no answers are shown. Each puzzle is only a picture to look at, join, circle or color.

faq.q: What if nobody wants puzzles today?
faq.a: Choose "Today is a rest day". The page then shows one calm line, and there is nothing to print or do.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page for the season you chose: its three puzzles, each with a short line of how to do it, and a line saying you can do one, two or all three.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

decorate-a-card.name: Decorate a card together
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Decorate a Card Together: a Printable Greeting Card
decorate-a-card.h1: Decorate a Card Together: Make One for Someone
decorate-a-card.description: Two people decorate a printed greeting card for a birthday, a thank you or just because, then write a message on the back together. Crayons or pens only. No timer or score. Free to print.
decorate-a-card.short: Decorate a printed greeting card together.
decorate-a-card.intro: A quiet making game for two people sitting side by side. You print one sheet, which folds in half to make a card. Choose an occasion, such as a birthday or a thank you, and decorate the front around its words. Then write a message on the back, together or one person writing what the other says. Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. There is no right card, and nothing is timed, scored or sent.
howTo: Khetha umcimbi, bese uthinta "Printa ikhadi".
Gobela ishidi libe phakathi ngomugca ophukileyo, ukuze ingaphambili ibe ngaphandle.
Omunye umuntu uhlobisa ingaphambili, omunye uhlobisa ingasemuva, noma nithatha amathuba esideni esisodwa.
Nibhale umlayezo ndawonye. Omunye angabhala kanti omunye asho amagama.
Yimani noma nini lapho nifisa khona. Ikhadi elilula lihle njengelinemininingwane eminingi.
tips: Qala ngamagama aphambili, bese wengeza amagatsha, izinkanyezi noma amachashaza azungezile, ngalinye ngesikhathi.
Uma umuntu engathandi ukudweba, angakhetha imibala noma abhale umlayezo.
Tshela ukuthi uyithanda kanjani imiklamo yomunye, kunokuthi ilungile yini.
Gcina ikhadi lapho lingapheselwa khona, noma nje libe etafuleni okwamanje.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho iwashi, amaphuzu, isibali sezinyathelo noma ukulahleka. Ungayeka noma nini, futhi ukuyeka uphakathi kuyindlela elungile yokuqeda.
Cha. Amakhilayoni, amapensela emibala noma amapeni anele. Akudingeki ukusika, ukunamathisela noma ukunamathelisa.
Khetha "Nje ngoba" ubhale amagama akho ingaphambili, noma uhlobise ikhadi ngaphandle komcimbi.

faq.q: Kukhona okubalwa, okugwetshwa noma okugcinwa esikrinini?
faq.a: Cha. Ikhasi likhombisa ikhadi nezinyathelo kuphela. Akukho okuhlelwa, okubalwa noma okugcinwa, futhi akukho ikhadi elilungile ngokuqinisekile.
Ikhasi elilodwa: ikhadi elibhukwe phakathi, linamagama omcimbi nohlaka olulula ingaphambili, nemigca yomlayezo nomugca othi Ovela kwa- ingasemuva. Imithetho yabantu ababili iphrintiwe ngaphansi.
Yebo, iyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kwisiphequluli sewebhu kufoni, kuthebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

find-together.name: Thola ndawonye
find-together.seoTitle: Thola Ndawonye: Abantu Ababili Bathola Amapheya
find-together.h1: Thola Ndawonye: Abantu Ababili, Iqembu Elilodwa
find-together.description: Abantu ababili bahlanganyela isikrini esisodwa futhi bashintshana ukuvula amakhadi ezithombe amabili ukuze bafune ipheya. Amapheya atholwa ndawonye futhi abalwe ohlwini olulodwa. Kuyadlalwa mahhala, akukho sikhathi noma amaphuzu.
find-together.short: Shintshanani nomuntu eseduze ukuthola amapheya ezithombe.
find-together.intro: Amakhadi aqala ngezithombe zawo ezibonakalayo, noma ningawabeka ngaphansi. Ngesikhathi senu nivula amakhadi amabili. Uma efana, nithole ipheya ndawonye, futhi isikhathi sidlulela komunye. Uma ehlukile, ahlala evulekile kuze kube yilapho ucindezela "Wabuyisa", ukuze nobabili nibheke. Ningadlulisa noma nini. Isikrini sitshela ukuthi isikhathi sobani, ngesiyingi sowokuqala nesikwele sowesibili.
Vula amakhadi amabili, enye ngemva kwenye. Uma efana, ipheya litholakele ndawonye.
Uma ehlukile, cindezela "Wabuyisa" nxa nobabili selilungele. Isikhathi sesidlulela komunye.
Noma ubani wenu angacindezela "Dlulisa" noma nini. Thinta "Qala kabusha" ukuthola amakhadi amasha, noma thinta Phumula ukuze umise.

Vumela umuntu omthandayo ukuthinta, nakuba kuthatha isikhathi. Khomba esikhundleni sokuthinta ngakhe.
Khetha "Amakhadi ahlala phansi" uma nobabili nithokoza ukuvula amakhadi ukuze nifune izithombe.
Umuntu odinwa kalula angadlulisa njalo njalo njengoba efisa. Amapheya asathola ndawonye.

Ahlala evulekile, ukuze nobabili nikwazi ukuwabheka isikhathi esidingekayo. Akukho okuwabuyisela ngokwawo. Uma nilungele, cindezela "Wabuyisa" futhi isikhathi sidlulela komunye umuntu.

faq.q: Ukudlala kwethu kuyagcinwa noma kuyathunyelwa yini?

story-dice.description: Amadayisi ezithombe ezintathu noma ezine okuxoxwa ngawo indaba, nganoma yiliphi ulandelwano. Akudingeki ukufunda, akukho mpendulo elungile, akukho sikhathi noma amaphuzu. Phonsa futhi, noma dlulisa. Kuyadlalwa futhi kuyashicilelwa mahhala.
story-dice.short: Phonsa amadayisi ezithombe uxoxe indaba ndawonye, nganoma yiliphi ulandelwano.
story-dice.players: abantu aba-2 noma ngaphezulu, noma umuntu omdala nengane
story-dice.intro: Dikhwana ezintathu noma ezine, njengamadayisi. Ndawonye, yakhani indaba esebenzisa lezi zithombe, noma kunjalo ngalo mlandu. Indaba ingaba yisivivinyo esisodwa noma ezimbalwa, ingaba yimpicabadala noma yeqiniso lokuphila. Alikho iindaba ezilungile, futhi akekho ozadingeka ukuthi aphe igama noma akhumbule okuthile. Thepha "Phonsa futhi" ukuze uthole izithombe ezintsha, futhi noma ubani angadlula.
howTo: Khetha amadayisi amathathu noma ezine. Amathathu ayelula kakhulu.
Bhekani izithombe ndawonye. Thepha elilodwa uma ufuna ukuqala ngalo.
Shintshanani ukuba nibalisane indaba esebenzisa izithombe, noma kunjalo ngalo mlandu. Isivivinyo esisodwa ngamunye sanele.
Noma ubani angadlula. Thepha "Dlula" futhi omunye ongaqala.
Thepha "Phonsa futhi" ukuze uthole izithombe ezintsha nanoma nini ofuna, noma thepha Phumula ukuze umise.

Engeza kokushiwo ngumuntu owedlule esikhundleni sokukulungisa. Noma iyiphi indaba iyilungile.

photo-pairs.intro: Kies twee tot zes eigen familiefoto's op je telefoon, tablet of computer. Ze worden dan een memoryspel met grote, goed zichtbare plaatjes. De foto's worden alleen op deze pagina getoond. Ze worden niet geüpload, opgeslagen of gedeeld, en ze verdwijnen zodra je de pagina sluit. Als je wilt, voeg je onder elke foto een paar woorden toe. Een zachte hint kan na een pauze naar één paar wijzen. Zo kijk je samen naar familiefoto's.
howTo: Tik op "Foto's kiezen" en kies twee tot zes foto's.
Elke foto verschijnt twee keer. Tik op één foto en daarna op de bijbehorende foto.
Als je wilt, voeg je onder elke foto een paar woorden toe. Bijschriften worden niet opgeslagen.
Praat over elke foto zodra je die vindt.
Als je klaar bent, sluit je de pagina of tik je op "Foto's wissen". Er wordt niets bewaard.
tips: Khetha izithombe ezicacile zezinto ezijabulisayo nezaziwayo: inja noma ikati, isigodi, indawo oyithandayo, usuku lomshado.
Izithombe zezindawo nezinto zingaba lula kunobuso, futhi azinakho ukucindezela ukuthi umuntu abizwe ngegama.
Gwema izithombe zabantu abashonile uma zingaletha usizi olubuhlungu ngokungazelelwa, ngaphandle uma wazi ukuthi zibaduduza.

faq.q: Ingabe izithombe zami ziyalayishwa noma yiphi indawo?
faq.a: Cha. Ikhasi lifunda izithombe ozikhethile ngqo kuwebhulawuzi yakho lizibonise esikrinini sakho. Azithunyelwa kithi noma komunye umuntu, futhi ziyanyamalala uma uvala noma uvuselela ikhasi.
Cha. Akukho iwashi, amaphuzu, isibali sokunyathela noma ukulahlekelwa. Ungayeka noma nini, futhi ukuyeka phakathi nendlela elungile yokuphetha.
Hhayi kuwebhulawuzi, ngenhloso, ukuze kungagcinwa lutho lwangasese. I-app ekhululekile ye-Creative Activities yeyi-iPhone ne-iPad ingagcina amakhophi ezithombe ozikhethile kumshini wakho.

picture-bingo.name: Ibingo lezithombe
picture-bingo.description: Gratis printbare beeldbingo voor gezinnen, groepen voor oudere mensen en zorginstellingen. Grote plaatjes met woorden, 9 of 16 vakjes en een grote roepfunctie op het scherm.
picture-bingo.short: Amakhadi ebingo lezithombe angashicilelwa nomeluleki omkhulu wamaqembu.
picture-bingo.intro: Ibingo elijwayelekile ngezithombe esikhundleni sezinombolo, ngakho akekho okudingeka afunde imibhalo emincane. Shicilela isethi yamakhadi ahlukile, bese usebenzisa umeluleki osesikrinini ukubonisa isithombe ngasinye sikhulu ku-TV, ilaptop noma ithabhulethi.
howTo: Khetha izikwele ezi-9 noma ezi-16 ekhadini ngalinye nenani labadlali.
Cofa “Shicilela amakhadi”. Ikhadi ngalinye liyahlukile.
Vula umeluleki esikrinini esikhulu. Cofa “Isithombe esilandelayo” ukubonisa isithombe ngasinye negama laso.
Abadlali bamboza isithombe esifanayo ekhadini labo ngomcu, inkinobho noma imaki.
Wonke umuntu ogcwalisa umugqa, noma ikhadi lonke, uthola ukuklaliswa. Kule nguqulo akekho ophuthileyo: qhubeka udlala kuze kube yilapho wonke umuntu enomugqa.
tips: Sebenzisa izinto ezinkulu njengamachecker noma amakepisi amabhodlela. Izinkinobho ezincane zingaba nzima ukuzithatha.
Bize isithombe usho okuthile ngaso: “Umkhumbi wezikhephu. Ubake waba ngaphezulu emanzini?”
Hlala abantu abanobunzima bokubona eduze kakhulu nesikrini, bese ubeka abasizi ngabadlali abadinga usizo.
Izikwele ezi-9 zanele iningi lamaqembu. Gcina isikhathi cishe imizuzu engama-20 kuya kwengama-30.

faq.q: Ngidlala kanjani ibingo lezithombe endaweni yokunakekela?
faq.a: Shicilela ikhadi elilodwa ngomdlali ngamunye, beka umeluleki esikrinini esikhulu osinaso, bese ubiza izithombe kancane, ubiza ngalinye ngegama. Dlala kuze kube yilapho wonke umuntu enomugqa, ukuze kungabikho ozishiyiwe.
Yebo. Shicilela amakhadi njengoba udinga, nanoma kangaki ofisa, ngokusetshenziswa komuntu siqu noma iqembu.
Yebo. Isikwele ngasinye sisithombe esikhulu, negama laso ngaphansi kwaso kwabathanda amagama.

picnic-planner.name: Picknickplanner
picnic-planner.seoTitle: Picknickplanner: kies plaatjes voor een uitje
picnic-planner.h1: Picknickplanner: kies plaatjes en zoek daarna de paren
picnic-planner.description: Kies plaatjes van eten en activiteiten voor een picknick en speel daarna een rustig memoryspel met die plaatjes. Er wordt niet op tijd gespeeld. Gratis om te spelen en te printen.
picnic-planner.short: Kies plaatjes van eten en uitjes voor een picknick en zoek daarna de paren.
picnic-planner.intro: Tik op plaatjes van eten en activiteiten om ze in een picknickmand te leggen. De mand past maximaal zes dingen. Een zin in woorden vertelt wat er in de mand zit, bijvoorbeeld "Onze picknick: brood, kaas, appels en een vlieger." Tik daarna op "Laten we spelen met onze picknick" voor een rustig memoryspel met de gekozen plaatjes. De plaatjes blijven zichtbaar, en er wordt niet op tijd gespeeld, niets geteld en niets opgeslagen. Met "Onze picknicklijst printen" print je een checklist van wat je hebt gekozen, met een vinkvakje bij elk ding om in te pakken.
howTo: Tik op een plaatje van eten of van iets om te doen. Het gaat in de mand.
Tik op een plaatje in de mand om het weer uit de mand te halen.
Kies minstens twee dingen en tik daarna op "Laten we spelen met onze picknick".
Tik op twee plaatjes die hetzelfde zijn. De plaatjes blijven zichtbaar, dus er is niets om te onthouden.
Tik op "Onze picknicklijst printen" voor een papieren checklist om mee te nemen.
tips: Vraag de mensen met wie je bent wat ze mee willen nemen, en kies de plaatjes samen uit.
Praat over elk plaatje zodra het in de mand gaat: "Weet je nog de vlieger die we op het strand lieten vliegen?"
Op papier zijn de lege lijnen voor alles wat je verder wilt meenemen, of voor een naam.

faq.q: Is er een timer, een score of een winnaar?
faq.a: Nee. Er wordt niet op tijd gespeeld, niets geteld en niemand wint. Het memoryspel heeft geen fouten en geen punten.
Nee. Het is een plaatjesplan voor een uitje, om samen over te praten en om op papier mee te nemen. Het zegt niet wat iemand moet eten.

faq.q: Worden de plaatjes die we kiezen opgeslagen of verstuurd?
faq.a: Nee. De mand blijft alleen op deze pagina. Hij wordt niet opgeslagen, geüpload of verstuurd, en hij is weg zodra je de pagina sluit.
Ja. Met "Onze picknicklijst printen" print je één pagina, op A4 of US Letter. Die toont de gekozen plaatjes met bij elk een vinkvakje, en lege lijnen voor alles wat je verder wilt.

faq.q: Is het gratis, en moet ik me aanmelden?
faq.a: Ja, het is gratis en er is geen account, aanmelding of download nodig. Het werkt in de webbrowser op een telefoon, tablet of computer.

scrapbook.name: Plakboek
scrapbook.seoTitle: Plakboek: draai samen door familiefoto's, pagina voor pagina
scrapbook.h1: Plakboek: voeg je foto's en bijschriften toe en blader daarna door de pagina's
scrapbook.description: Kies op je apparaat twee tot twaalf eigen familiefoto's en blader er als een boek doorheen, met een paar woorden onder elke foto. Er wordt niets geüpload. Gratis om te printen.
scrapbook.short: Blader samen door je eigen familiefoto's, als in een boek.
scrapbook.intro: Kies twee tot twaalf eigen foto's van dit apparaat. Elke foto wordt een pagina van een boek, groot genoeg om goed te zien, met daaronder optioneel een paar woorden. Blader met de knoppen of de pijltjestoetsen, en gebruik "Samen bekijken" om naast elkaar alleen de foto's en woorden te bekijken. Je foto's blijven op dit apparaat. Ze worden niet geüpload of opgeslagen, en het boek verdwijnt zodra je de pagina sluit. Met "Het plakboek printen" print je op elke pagina één foto met de woorden erbij, en met paginanummers.
howTo: Tik op "Foto's kiezen" en kies twee tot twaalf foto's. Vraag eerst toestemming voordat je een foto gebruikt van iemand die geen ja kan zeggen.
Blader met "Vorige pagina" en "Volgende pagina", of met de pijltjestoetsen links en rechts.
Voeg onder een foto desgewenst een paar woorden toe. Gebruik "Eerder zetten" of "Later zetten" om de volgorde te veranderen.
Tik op "Samen bekijken" om de bewerkknoppen te verbergen en het boek naast elkaar te bekijken.
Tik op "Het plakboek printen" voor een papieren exemplaar, of op "Het boek wissen" als je klaar bent. Er wordt niets bewaard.
tips: Wähle Fotos von fröhlichen, vertrauten Dingen: einem Garten, einem Haustier, einem Lieblingsort. Sprecht über jede Seite, während ihr umblättert.
Lassen Sie die Person zu jeder Seite ein paar Worte sagen, auch nur ein einziges Wort, und schreiben Sie diese genau so auf, wie sie gesagt werden.
Auf Papier können die gedruckten Seiten in einen Ordner kommen, und die Familie kann eigene Bilder und Notizen rund um sie herum ergänzen.

faq.q: Gibt es eine Zeitmessung, eine Punktzahl oder einen Gewinner?
faq.a: Nein. Nichts wird gemessen, bewertet oder gezählt, und niemand gewinnt. Die Seitenzahl dient nur dazu, dass Sie wissen, wo Sie im Buch sind.

faq.q: Werden unsere Fotos oder Bildunterschriften gespeichert, hochgeladen oder gesendet?
faq.a: Nein. Die Fotos werden nur von dieser Seite gelesen und nicht hochgeladen, gespeichert oder irgendwohin gesendet. Die Bildunterschriften bleiben nur geöffnet, solange die Seite offen ist. Wenn Sie die Seite schließen, ist das Buch weg.
Ja. „Das Fotoalbum drucken“ druckt auf jeder Seite ein Foto und seine Bildunterschrift, mit Seitenzahlen. Wählen Sie im Druckdialog A4 oder US Letter.

faq.q: Ist es kostenlos, und muss man sich anmelden?
faq.a: Ja, es ist kostenlos, und es gibt kein Konto, keine Anmeldung und keinen Download. Es funktioniert im Webbrowser auf einem Handy, Tablet oder Computer.

collage-board.name: Collage-Tafel
collage-board.seoTitle: Collage-Tafel: Zwei Personen legen abwechselnd Bilder aus
collage-board.h1: Collage-Tafel: Bilder abwechselnd auf einer Tafel legen
collage-board.description: Zwei Personen legen abwechselnd ausgeschnittene Bilder auf eine gemeinsame Tafel. Tippen Sie auf ein Ausschnittbild und dann auf einen freien Platz. Keine Zeitmessung und keine Punkte. Kostenlos zu spielen und zu drucken.
collage-board.short: Legen Sie abwechselnd Bilder auf eine gemeinsame Tafel.
collage-board.intro: Zwei Personen sitzen nebeneinander vor einer Tafel mit zwölf Plätzen und einem Tablett mit acht ausgeschnittenen Bildern. Tippen Sie auf ein Ausschnittbild und dann auf einen freien Platz, dann kommt das Bild dorthin. Danach ist die andere Person an der Reihe. Die Bilder jeder Person haben ihre eigene Form, einen Kreis oder ein Quadrat, sodass die Tafel zeigt, wer was gelegt hat, ohne sich auf Farben zu verlassen. Jede Person darf aussetzen, und ein Schritt kann zurückgenommen werden. Nichts wird gemessen, bewertet oder gespeichert. „Die Tafel drucken“ druckt die leere Tafel und die Bilder zum Ausschneiden.
howTo: Tippen Sie auf ein Bild im Tablett. Solange es ausgewählt ist, steht dort „Ausgewählt“.
Tippen Sie auf einen freien Platz auf der Tafel. Das Ausschnittbild kommt dorthin, und die Reihe wechselt.
Jede Person kann jederzeit auf „Aussetzen“ tippen oder auf „Letztes Teil zurücknehmen“, um einen Schritt rückgängig zu machen.
Tippen Sie auf „Andere Bilder“ für ein anderes Tablett. Bilder, die schon auf der Tafel liegen, bleiben, wo sie sind.
Tippen Sie auf „Neu beginnen“, um die Tafel zu leeren, und auf „Zurücklegen“, wenn Sie es sich anders überlegen.
tips: Sagen Sie den Namen jedes Bildes, während es gelegt wird, etwa „die Teetasse kommt neben das Haus“. Das Sprechen macht die Tätigkeit zu einer gemeinsamen.
Lassen Sie die beiden Personen abwechselnd das Ausschnittbild und den Platz wählen, damit jede mitbestimmen kann.
Auf Papier schneiden Sie die acht Bilder mit etwas Hilfe aus und legen sie dann auf die gedruckten Felder.

faq.q: Gibt es eine Zeitmessung, eine Punktzahl oder einen Gewinner?
faq.a: Nein. Nichts wird gemessen, bewertet oder gezählt, und niemand gewinnt. Eine volle Tafel ist einfach eine, auf der an jedem Platz ein Bild liegt.

faq.q: Werden die Bilder, die wir legen, gespeichert oder gesendet?
faq.a: Nein. Die Tafel bleibt nur auf dieser Seite. Sie wird nicht gespeichert, hochgeladen oder gezählt und ist weg, wenn Sie die Seite schließen.

faq.q: Woran erkennen wir, welches Bild wem gehört?
faq.a: Jede Person hat eine Form. Die Bilder der ersten Person haben in der Ecke einen Kreis, die der zweiten Person ein Quadrat, und über der Tafel wird jeweils der Name angezeigt.

faq.q: Gibt es eine Version auf Papier?
faq.a: Ja. „Die Tafel drucken“ druckt die leere Tafel als zwölf Kästchen, darunter die acht Bilder in derselben Größe und mit der Schnittlinie. Das Ausschneiden kann eine erwachsene Person übernehmen.

faq.q: Ist es kostenlos, und muss man sich anmelden?
faq.a: Ja, es ist kostenlos, und es gibt kein Konto, keine Anmeldung und keinen Download. Es funktioniert im Webbrowser auf einem Handy, Tablet oder Computer.

garden-planner.name: Gartenplaner
garden-planner.seoTitle: Gartenplaner: Ein Beet aus Pflanzenbildern gestalten
garden-planner.h1: Gartenplaner: Bilder auswählen und ein Beet gestalten
garden-planner.description: Wählen Sie Bilder von Pflanzen und Gartendingen und legen Sie sie in zwölf Beete einer Fläche. Tippen Sie auf ein Bild und dann auf ein Beet. Keine Zeitmessung und keine Punkte. Kostenlos zu spielen und zu drucken.
garden-planner.short: Wählen Sie Pflanzenbilder und gestalten Sie eine Fläche mit zwölf Beeten.
garden-planner.intro: Wählen Sie Bilder aus einem Tablett mit Pflanzen und Gartendingen und tippen Sie dann auf ein Beet, um jedes Bild dort einzusetzen. Eine Fläche hat zwölf Beete, und in einem Beet liegt ein Bild. Eine Zusammenfassung in Worten sagt, was der Plan enthält, etwa „Ihr Plan hat 3 Sonnenblumen, 2 Rosen und 1 Baum.“ Nichts wird gemessen, bewertet oder gespeichert, und es gibt keine Reihenfolge. Das ist ein Bildplan zum Besprechen, keine Anleitung zum Pflanzen. „Den Plan drucken“ druckt die Beete mit den gewählten Bildern, dazu leere Beete zum Zeichnen und Linien für Notizen.
howTo: Tippen Sie auf ein Bild im Tablett. Solange es ausgewählt ist, steht dort „Ausgewählt“.
Tippen Sie auf ein Beet. Das Bild kommt dorthin, und die Auswahl ist abgelegt.
Um ein Beet zu ändern, wählen Sie ein anderes Bild und tippen Sie auf das Beet. Um ein Beet zu leeren, tippen Sie darauf, wenn kein Bild ausgewählt ist.
Tippen Sie auf „Neu beginnen“, um alle Beete zu leeren, und auf „Zurücklegen“, wenn Sie es sich anders überlegen.
Tippen Sie auf „Den Plan drucken“ für eine Papierkopie der Fläche und der Zusammenfassung.
tips: Ŋeka isithombe ngasinye ngesikhathi esingena ngaso, njengo"usunifulawa uyabekwa ngasendlini yezinyoni". Ukukhuluma kwenza umsebenzi ube wokwabelana.
Vumela umuntu ngamunye akhethe isithombe ngokuphendukana, noma nikhethe izithombe ndawonye, ukuze bobabili babe nelungelo lokuthi ngabe icebo lenziwa kanjani.
Ephepheni, izindawo ezingenalutho zokutshala zilungele ukudweba imibono yakho, kanti imigqa yamanothi ilungele noma yini ofuna ukuyikhumbula.

faq.a: Cha. Lolu luhlelo lwezithombe lokukhuluma ngalo, hhayi iseluleko sokutshala. Alushongo ukuthi kumelwe ukutshalwe nini, kuphi noma kanjani, ngoba lokho kuncike endaweni ohlala kuyo.
Cha. Akukho okulinganiselwa ngesikhathi, okunikezwa amaphuzu, okunikezwa izinkomba noma okubalwayo, futhi akekho owinayo. Isheke eligcwele alithola umyalezo okhethekile.
Cha. Icebo lihlala kule khasi kuphela. Alilondolozwa, alilayishwa noma libalwe, futhi liyanyamalala uma uvala ikhasi.

Yebo. I-"Phrinta icebo" iphrinta ikhasi elilodwa, ku-A4 noma ku-US Letter. Likhombisa izindawo ezilishumi nambili ezine-zithombe ozikhethile, isifinyezo ngamagama, kanye nemigqa engenalutho yamanothi.
Yebo, ayikhokhelwa, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu efonini, ethebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

coloring-wall.name: Udonga lokudweba ngokuhlanganyela
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Udonga Lokudweba Ngokuhlanganyela: Isithombe Esisodwa Ngezandla Eziningi
coloring-wall.h1: Udonga Lokudweba Ngokuhlanganyela: Isithombe Esikhulu Esidwetshwe Ndawonye
coloring-wall.description: Phrinta isithombe esikhulu esihlanganisa amakhasi amaningi, ukuze umndeni, ikilasi noma indlu yokunakekela bakwazi ukudweba udonga olulodwa ndawonye. Kuyamahhala ukuphrinta. Akukho sikhathi noma amaphuzu.
coloring-wall.short: Phrinta isithombe esikhulu esihlanganisa amakhasi ukuze abantu abaningi bakudwebe.
coloring-wall.intro: Khetha isithombe emakhasini okudweba, kanye nodonga lwamakhasi angu-4, angu-6 noma angu-9. Phrinta udonga: ikhasi lokuqala likhombisa indlela yokulihlanganisa, kanti amanye amakhasi ngaminye ingxenye yesithombe esisodwa, nelebula elifana no-A1 ekhoneni lalo. Umuntu ngamunye udweba ikhasi elilodwa noma amakhasi amaningi, nangaziphi izinkomba nangesitayela esiyikhethayo. Amakhasi abe esehlelwa ngokwamalebula alo, aphinde ahlanganiswe ngetheyiphu ngasemuva. Akukho okulinganiselwa ngesikhathi, okunikezwa amaphuzu noma okulondolozwayo.
howTo: Khetha isithombe, bese ukhetha ukuthi udonga linamakhasi amangaki.
Funda imephu esikrinini, ekhombisa ukuthi yiliphi lebula elihamba kuphi.
Thinta "Phrinta udonga" uphrinte onke amakhasi.
Nikeza umuntu ngamunye ikhasi elilodwa noma amaningi okudweba. Izinkomba nezitayela akudingi ukuthi zifane.
Hlela amakhasi ngokwamalebula awo, bese uwahlanganisa ngetheyiphu ngasemuva.
tips: Nikeza amakhasi anemigqa elula kulabo abafuna umsebenzi ophephile, kanti amakhasi anemininingwane amaningi unikeze labo abawathandayo.
Phakamisa udonga lapho wonke umuntu angalibona khona, nixoxe ngezingxenye ndawonye.
Khetha udonga oluncane etafuleni elincane, nolukhulu egumbini.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho okulinganiselwa ngesikhathi, okunikezwa amaphuzu noma okubalwayo, futhi akekho owinayo. Udonga lisiyisithombe esidwetshwe abantu abaningi.

faq.q: Amakhasi agcinwa noma athunyelwa kwenye indawo?
faq.a: Cha. Udonga lwenziwa kule khasi kuphela. Alilondolozwa, alilayishwa noma libalwe, futhi liyanyamalala uma uvala ikhasi.
Cha. Wonke umuntu angasebenzisa imibala nesitayela esisiyo. Amakhasi asahlangana aqede sibe isithombe esisodwa.
Yebo. Udonga oluphrintiwe ngumdlalo ophelele: ikhasi lokuqala elinezinyathelo nemephu, nekhasi elilodwa ngalinye lengxenye yesithombe.
Yebo, ayikhokhelwa, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu efonini, ethebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

quiet-shapes.name: Umdlalo wezimo ophephile
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Umdlalo Wezimo Ophephile: Faka Izimo Esithombeni
quiet-shapes.h1: Umdlalo Wezimo Ophephile: Faka Izingxenye Esithombeni
quiet-shapes.description: Faka izimo ezilula emugqeni wendlu, wesikebhe, wenhlanzi nokunye okuningi. Thinta ingxenye, bese uthinta indawo enesimo esifanayo. Akukho sikhathi noma amaphuzu. Kuyamahhala ukudlala nokuphrinta.
quiet-shapes.short: Faka izimo ezilula esithombeni, ngesivinini sakho.
quiet-shapes.intro: Umugqa wesithombe, njengendlu, isikebhe noma irokhethi, uhlukaniswe ngezindawo. Indawo ngayinye inengxenye yesimo esifanayo, into enxantathu enkulu noma encane, isikwele, isikwele esiphambeneyo noma unxande. Thinta ingxenye, bese uthinta indawo enesimo esifanayo, bese iyangena. Indawo iyiphendulela ingxenye ngawe, ngakho akudingeki ukuthi uyidonse noma uyiphendule. Uma ingxenye inesimo esihlukile kwendawo, ihlala ethreyini nenothi emfushane. Akukho okulinganiselwa ngesikhathi noma okunikezwa amaphuzu, futhi akukho okugcinwa noma okuthunyelwa. I-"Phrinta lesi simo" iphrinta umugqa nezingxenye zawo ekhasini elilodwa ukuze udwebe noma ugawule.
howTo: Thinta ingxenye ethreyini. Ibonisa "Ikhethiwe" lapho ikhethiwe.
Thinta indawo esithombeni. Uma isimo sifana, ingxenye iyangena lapho.
Uma kungafani, zama enye indawo. Akulahleki lutho ngokuzama.
Thinta ingxenye esithombeni ukuze iphinde ibuyele ethreyini, noma sebenzisa "Qala kabusha" ukuze zonke ziphinde zibuyele.
Lapho yonke indawo inengxenye yayo, isithombe siphelile. Thinta "Esinye isimo" ukuze uthole esisha, noma thinta Phumula ukuze umise.
tips: Tuthukisa imigca yesikhombisi ukuze ubone isikhala ngasinye. Yivale ukuze kube yinkinga engaphezulu, uzuze ukubona kuphela umugca wangaphandle.
Qala ngezimo ezinkulu, njengo-triangle amakhulu kanye namakhonco. Izingcezu ezincane zivame ukuza ekugcineni.
Bhala amagama ezimo ngelizwi uma uqhubeka: "i-triangle, isikwele, i-rectangle ende". Ukukhuluma kungenza kube yinto yokwabelana.
Ephepheni, phaqa izingcezu ngemibala emibili noma emithathu, noma uzinqume nomuntu omdala esiza.

faq.q: Kukhona isikhathi, amaphuzu noma ukubala izinyathelo?
faq.a: Cha. Akukho okulinganiselwa ngesikhathi, okubaliwe noma okunikezwa amaphuzu. Isingcezu esingalingani asibekwa, futhi ungayeka noma nini.
Cha. Isithombe sihlala kule khasi kuphela. Asigcinwa, asilayishwa noma sibalwe, futhi siyanyamalala uma uvala ikhasi.

faq.q: Ingabe izikhala zikhulu ngokwanele ngesandla esizamazamayo noma iskrini esincane?
faq.a: Umugca wangaphandle udwetshwe ubukhulu obuvumelwa yiskrini, futhi isikhala ngasinye yinkinobho ongayifinyelela ngomunwe noma ngokhiye we-Tab. Izingcezu esitsheni yizinkinobho ezinkulu zekhasi.

Yebo. "Phrinta lesi simo" iphrinta isithombe esisodwa ekhasini elilodwa: umugca wangaphandle nemigca yesisekelo, kanye nezingcezu ezidwetshwe ngobukhulu obufanayo ecaleni kwawo. Phaqa izingcezu, noma uzinqume ukuze zilingane. Umuntu omdala angazinquma.
Yebo, iyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu esiselufoni, ethebhulethini noma ekhompyutheni.

calm-breathing.name: Ukuphefumula ngokuthula
calm-breathing.description: Ukuphumula okuncane nokuthulile ngokuphefumula okuzabelwana: isangqa esincane sikhula sincipha imiphefumulo eyisithupha. Wena uyaqala, futhi ungayeka nanoma nini.
calm-breathing.short: Isangqa esihamba kancane ophefumula kuso. Qala uyeke njengoba kukuthanda.
calm-breathing.intro: Ngezinye izikhathi umsebenzi omuhle kakhulu ukuphumula okuthulile. Cofa “Qala”, bese uphefumula ngenkathi isangqa sikhula, uphefumule ngaphandle ngenkathi sincipha. Khetha isivinini esihamba kancane noma esisheshayo. Akusona ukwelashwa, kodwa umzuzu wokuthula wokwabelana.
howTo: Hlalani ngokuthula ecaleni komunye nomunye.
Khetha isivinini: esihamba kancane noma esithulile.
Cofa “Qala”. Phefumula ngenkathi isangqa sikhula, uphefumule ngaphandle ngenkathi sincipha.
Sima ngokwaso ngemiphefumulo eyisithupha, noma cofa “Ima” noma nini ofisa.
tips: Bambelela ngesandla noma ubeke isandla esihlakaleni somuntu uma lokho kwamukeleka.
Ungaphoqi. Uma befuna ukubukela, kulungile.
Uma umuntu enenkinga yokuphefumula, phefumula njengoba ujwayelekile ubuke isangqa kuphela. Buza udokotela ngazo zonke izinkinga zokuphefumula.

faq.a: Cha. Kuyisikhathi esilula, esingakhethwa ngokuthula nokuba nomunye. Akusona ukwelashwa kokukhathazeka noma kwanoma yisiphi isimo. Khuluma nodokotela ngezinkinga zempilo.

faq.q: Isangqa siyanyakaza ngaphandle kokuthi mina ngiqale?
faq.a: Cha. Akukho okunyakazayo kuze kube yilapho uthinta u-Qala, futhi kuyeka ngemva kwamaphefumulo ayisithupha noma uma uthinta u-Misa. Uma idivaysi yakho imiselwe ukunciphisa ukunyakaza, amagama ayashintsha kodwa isiyingi asikhuli.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu kufoni, kuthebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

story-chain.name: Ketanga yezindaba
story-chain.h1: Ketanga Yezindaba: Xoxa Indaba Isithombe Ngesithombe
story-chain.description: Umugqa wezithombe uyakhula kancane kancane, futhi ngamunye uthi umusho owodwa ngaphezulu kwawo. Akukho okudingeka uthayiphe, futhi akukho mpendulo engalungile. Mahhala, uthule, akukho sikhathi namaphuzu.
story-chain.short: Engeza isithombe, bese ngamunye usho umusho, ngokuphendukisana.
story-chain.intro: Umdlalo uqala ngesithombe esisodwa, bese ketanga iyakhula isithombe ngesithombe. Ngamunye usho umusho owodwa mayelana neketanga kuze kube manje, ngokuzwakalayo, ngokuphendukisana. Umusho ungaba ngalokho okubonayo, indawo ekhumbuzayo, noma into ehlekisayo. Akukho okubhalwayo, okuqoshiwe noma okugcinwayo, akukho mpendulo elungile, futhi noma ubani angadlula. Ketanga iyama ezithombeni eziyisishiyagalombili, bese ungaqala enye.
howTo: Bheka isithombe sokuqala ndawonye.
Phendukisana: ngamunye usho umusho owodwa mayelana neketanga kuze kube manje. Noma ubani angadlula.
Thepha "Engeza isithombe" ukubeka isithombe esilandelayo ekugcineni kweketanga.
Thepha "Susa okokugcina" uma ufisa ukubuyela esithombeni esedlule.
Lapho ketanga inezithombe ezisishiyagalombili, thepha "Qala ketanga entsha" ukuthola enye emisha, noma yeka nje.
tips: Okufushane kulungile: "Umuntu ubeke ibhayi phezu komlilo." Umuntu olandelayo uyaqhubeka, noma adlule.
Vumela izithombe zihole. Awukho umlando okufanele ufike kuwo.
Yeka noma nini ufisa. Ukuyeka phakathi kuyindlela elungile yokuqeda.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho iwashi, amaphuzu, ukubala izinyathelo noma ukulahlekelwa. Ungayeka noma nini, futhi ukuyeka phakathi kuyindlela elungile yokuqeda.
Cha. Imisho ishiwo ngokuzwakalayo futhi ayibhalwa, ayiqoshwa noma ithunyelwe noma kuphi. Umdlalo ubonisa izithombe kuphela.

faq.q: Yini uma umuntu engafuni ukushoa lutho?
faq.a: Noma ubani angadlula, futhi omunye ulandela. Akekho okudingeka abize noma akhumbule isithombe.
Yebo, iyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu esiselufoni, ethebhulethini noma ekhompyutheni.

quiet-scene.name: Isimo esithulile
quiet-scene.h1: Isimo Esithulile: Isithombe Esisodwa Esinganyakazi Ngesikhathi
quiet-scene.description: Isithombe esikhulu esisodwa esingenyakazi ngesikhathi, ngasinye nomugqa omncane ophansi kwaso. Cindezela Okulandelayo noma Okwangaphambili uma usulungele. Akukho okunyakazayo noma okudlalayo ngokwaso, futhi akukho sikhathi namaphuzu. Kuyamahhala, ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti.
quiet-scene.short: Bheka isithombe esisodwa ngesikhathi, ngesivinini sakho.
quiet-scene.intro: Isithombe esikhulu esisodwa sigcwalisa iskrini, nomugqa omfushane ophansi kwaso. Cindezela "Isithombe esilandelayo" noma "Isithombe esedlule" uma usulungele esinye. Akukho okunyakazayo, okufiphalayo noma okushintshayo ngokwaso, futhi akukho okubalwa ngesikhathi. Thepha "Isithombe esikhulu" ukuze ubonise isithombe kuphela, ukuzeigumbi lonke likibone ethelevishini.
howTo: Bheka isithombe ndawonye.
Funda umugqa ophansi kwaso ngokuzwakalayo uma uthanda.
Cindezela "Isithombe esilandelayo" noma "Isithombe esedlule" uma usulungele.
Thepha "Isithombe esikhulu" ukuze ubonise isithombe kuphela, no-"Bonisa konke" ukubuyisa okunye.
Yeka noma nini ufisa ngo-"Ngiqede okwamanje".
tips: Vumela umuntu akhethe lapho efuna ukuqhubeka: lindela ukuthi abheke, bese ucindezela Okulandelayo.
Ngeqembu, sebenzisa "Isithombe esikhulu" ethelevishini noma eskrinini elikhulu, uhlale lapho bonke bekubona khona.
Akukho indlela eyodwa efanele yokubheka isithombe. Ukukhuluma ngaso nje kuyisenzo esiphelele.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho iwashi, amaphuzu, ukubala izinyathelo noma ukulahlekelwa. Ungayeka noma nini, futhi ukuyeka phakathi kuyindlela elungile yokuqeda.
Cha. Akukho msindo, futhi akukho okunyakazayo, okufiphalayo noma okushintshayo ngokwaso. Isithombe sishintsha kuphela uma ucindezela inkinobho.
Cha. Lokhu sithombe esibukwa ndawonye esikrinini. Isithombe osithandayo noma ikhadi lepositi etafuleni lenza into efanayo.
Yebo, ayikhokhelwa, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kubhulawuza yewebhu kufoni, kuthebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

color-wash.name: Ukugeza ngemibala
color-wash.seoTitle: Ukugeza ngemibala: Umbala othambileyo ngaphezu kwekhasi
color-wash.h1: Ukugeza ngemibala: Pendela umbala othambileyo ngaphezu kwekhasi
color-wash.description: Ibhulashi elithambileyo lipendela ukugeza okubanzi nokukhanyayo kombala ngaphezu kwekhasi elilodwa, ngemibala emine nobukhulu bamabhulashi amabili. Akukho siphetho, akukho mphumela, akukho sikhathi. Kuyamahhala ukudlala, ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti.
color-wash.short: Pendela ukugeza okuthambileyo ngemibala ngaphezu kwekhasi, ngesivinini sakho.
color-wash.players: Wedwa, noma abantu aba-2 begcine ndawonye
color-wash.intro: Ikhasi elilodwa nebhulashi elithambileyo elilodwa. Khetha umbala nobukhulu bebhulashi, bese uhuda ngaphezu kwekhasi ukuze wendlale ukugeza kombala. Ikhasi alinasiphetho: akukho okudingeka kuqedwe, akukho isithombe okudingeka sithi silungile, akukho mphumela. Ngendlela oyithandayo, yenza ukugeza okuningi, noma beka phansi ibhulashi ubheke nje. Ikhasi elisha lisusa konke, futhi Buyisela kubuyisa okwagezwa.
howTo: Khetha umbala. Umbala ngamunye unegama lawo elibhaliwe.
Khetha Obanzi noma Obanzi kakhulu. Obanzi kakhulu umboza ikhasi eliningi ngocansi ngalunye.
Huda ngaphezu kwekhasi ngomunwe, ngomshini wokuchofoza noma ngepeni ukuze wendlale ukugeza.
Noma sebenzisa amanqamu esikhombisi ukuze uhambise insika yebhulashi, no-Space ukubeka phansi noma ukuphakamisa ibhulashi.
Thepha "Ikhasi elisha" ukuze usule ikhasi, bese "Buyisela" uma ufuna ukugeza kubuyele.
tips: Vumela omunye umuntu akhethe umbala wokugeza olandelayo, nixoxe ngemibala njengoba iyafakwa.
Obanzi kakhulu kulula ukuqondisa ngesandla esinyakazayo, ngoba ibhulashi kadingi ukuba nembala.
Akukho indlela efanele yokupenda. Yima noma nini ofuna, noma thepha "Kuqedile okwamanje".

faq.a: Cha. Ikhasi alinasiphetho. Akukho okuqedwayo, okubalwayo, okulinganiselwa isikhathi noma okunikezwa amaphuzu, futhi akukho umlayezo ocela ukuthi wenze okwengeziwe.
Cha. Akukho okugcinwayo, okushicilelwayo noma okuthunyelwayo noma kuphi. Ukugeza kuhlala kulelikhasi kuze kube yilapho ulishiya.

faq.q: Ngingasebenzisa lokhu ngaphandle komshini wokuchofoza noma isikrini sokuthinta?
faq.a: Yebo. Uma ikhasi linokugxila, amanqamu esikhombisi ahambisa insika yebhulashi, futhi inkinobho ye-Space ibeka phansi noma iphakamisa ibhulashi. Isikrini sithi "Ibhulashi phansi" noma "Ibhulashi phezulu" njalo lapho.
Cha. Ukupenda ngamanzi ephepheni kunombono ofanayo, ibhulashi elimanzi nomumbala owodwa ngesikhathi, ngakho kuyisenzo esihlukile okungazama etafuleni.

Okuphuzi, okuwolintshi, okuluhlaza nokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okumfusa, imibala emine efanayo esetshenziswa kwezinye izinhlelo zethu zezithombe ezidlalwayo. Ngalinye linegama lalo elibhaliwe, futhi igama libonakala eduze kokukhetha.
Yebo, ayikhokhelwa, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kubhulawuza yewebhu kufoni, kuthebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.
